name: NE5534 / NE5534A / SA5534 / SE5534 / NJM5534
tagline: Signetics' 1979 low-noise single, forerunner of the 5532: ~3.5 nV/√Hz, 10 MHz, drives 600 Ω. Console and preamp staple.

lineage.note: Original design ('JULY 1979' on TI sheets); Albuquerque fabs FAB22/FAB23. 1979 Analog Applications Manual on archive.org.
Product specs 1994-08-31 and 2001-08-03. Laser marking reportedly replaced Signetics pad printing. NXP from 2006.
SLOS070: 1990 edition, B 2004-02, C 2004-09, D 2014-11 (current). NE5532 PCNs do not cover NE5534.
NE5534/D (Rev. 3 2012-07, Rev. 4 2024-12) covers NE/SA/SE5534 and A grades; product page live.

lineage.vendor: JRC / New Japan Radio / Nisshinbo Micro Devices
lineage.note: NJM5534D/M obsolete; NJM5534DD current. Community lore says it is a separate die.
Reported only; no ST NE5534 datasheet found.

part_numbers.note: Commercial grade, 0–70 °C. TI PDIP (P) and SOIC (D/DR); TI and onsemi pages live.
Low-noise grade with tighter noise specs. Some distributors have listed variants obsolete.
TI SOIC tube; EOL via PDN# 20230522005.3 (RoHS/REACH). Replaced by NE5534ADRG4.
Green (G4) reel; TI says same core device. Not NRND or last-buy.
DIP (Signetics/Philips, onsemi). Vintage parts sold as NOS; onsemi NE5534AN at Mouser.
onsemi SOIC-8 tape and reel, Pb-free (NE5534/D ordering information).
Industrial −40 to 85 °C. In TI SLOS070C/D (maybe B) and onsemi NE5534/D.
Military −55 to 125 °C. In 1990 TI edition and onsemi title; dropped by SLOS070C.
JRC DIP8/SOP8, ±22 V. Used in AKM AK5383 reference (M0049-E-03). Bee Technologies model ©2007.
Current JRC DIP8 (DigiKey, Mouser). SOP NJM5534MD suggested but unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: ±3 V to ±20 V; abs max ±22 V; 30 V headline
key_specs.condition: TI NE5532 redesign: ±18 V abs max
low gain: cap between pins 5 and 8

reputation.summary: The single, decompensated forerunner of the NE5532: quieter, and it drives 600 Ω. Douglas Self covers it, Dave Jones (EEVblog) treats it as a low-noise default, and it fills console, phono, mic, CD and DAC stages. diyAudio says it sounds good when compensated. Soomal rates the Creative AE-9's TI NE5534 below the LM49710. Japanese fans prize Signetics/Philips NOS.
typical_uses: CD/DAC I/V and LPF (Matrix HPA-2 Classic)
ADC drivers (AKM AK5383 reference uses NJM5534)
Sound-card op-amp sockets (Creative AE-9 ships TI NE5534)
caveats: Decompensated: low-gain or unity-gain sockets need the COMP to COMP/BAL capacitor, or it may oscillate.
Brands (Signetics/Philips, TI, onsemi, JRC) are separate products; verify stability when swapping. TI's 5532 and 5534 differ.
TI NE5534AD (SOIC tube) is EOL; use NE5534ADRG4. Distributors sometimes show active variants as obsolete.
TI's NE5532 redesign (PCN20231114002.1: ±22 V→±18 V abs max, 2 kV→1 kV ESD) does not cover NE5534 yet.
JRC NJM5534D/M are obsolete; the current JRC part is NJM5534DD.

counterfeit_notes: Marketplaces sell 'Signetics / former Philips NE5534N' NOS; remarked fakes are reported but unverified. Genuine HP house-numbered Signetics parts exist. Check marking era and date code, buy current production from authorised distributors, and bench-check noise and stability.

silicon_changes.identification: Claimed: older parts have pad-printed (tampo) Signetics marking, later ones laser-marked Philips. Not vendor-documented.
silicon_changes.summary: Japanese blogs (radiokits.jp, takinx) claim Signetics masters were lost in the 2000 Philips Albuquerque fab fire and Philips redrew the layout. Signetics did run Albuquerque fabs (FAB22/FAB23), but nothing links a fire to an NE5534 redesign. A rival claim blames a Caen fab fire for ending NXP's 553x production.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Anecdotal only: Japanese listeners prefer older pad-printed Signetics NOS parts. No measurements.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: no documented datasheet change; unverified folklore
silicon_changes.verification: No vendor PCN or datasheet supports either fire claim; the Signetics Albuquerque fabs are documented.

silicon_changes.vendor: Multiple second sources (Signetics/Philips vs TI vs onsemi vs JRC NJM5534)
silicon_changes.identification: Manufacturer logo and prefix on the package (Signetics/Philips 'N' suffix, TI logo, ON logo, JRC 'NJM').
silicon_changes.summary: Each vendor sells its own part under the generic number; GroupDIY posters say each uses its own mask. Forums and Japanese blogs report behavioural and sonic differences. Vendor-specific SPICE models exist (NJM5534, NE5534ON, NE5534PH, NE5534TI). Datasheet deltas between vendors were not retrieved.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Community reports rank Signetics/Philips above TI/JRC (anecdotal). Stability margins in low-gain positions may differ.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium: check stability and compensation when swapping brands in low-gain sockets
silicon_changes.verification: Reported by GroupDIY, Head-Fi and Japanese blogs; no vendor documentation.

revision_history.changes: 'JULY 1979 - REVISED SEPTEMBER 1990'. Title 'NE5534, NE5534A, SE5534, SE5534A' with military SE grades (−55 to 125 °C). No change log.
Unconfirmed; SA grades reportedly replaced SE. Change list not retrieved; whether SLOS070A exists is unknown.
Title 'NE5534, NE5534A, SA5534, SA5534A' (SE dropped); has an Ordering Information table. No electrical change indicated.
New template ('NE5534x, SA5534x'): added application, handling, layout and support sections; deleted Ordering Information. No electrical changes.
NE5534AD discontinued (last-time-buy, EOL), reportedly RoHS/REACH; NE5534ADRG4 replaces it. Number suggests 2023.

open_questions: Does TI PCN 20231114002 list the NE5534 as end of life? Product pages say active; read its device list.
Does SLOS070A exist, and is the Feb 2004 SLOS070B (ampslab copy) real? Watch for SLOS070E or an NE5534 PCN.
Which NE5534/D revisions do the Mouser, RS and pub/Collateral copies hold? What is onsemi's lifecycle status?
Philips/NXP URL, dates and discontinuation? NJM5534 Ver. and NJM5534MD? Did ST ever make the NE5534?
Retrieve current noise, Iq, THD+N, output current and the compensation conditions behind 13 V/µs and 10 MHz.

claims_confirmed: SLOS070D (revised Nov 2014) is the current datasheet; Rev C to D changes are template sections plus deleting Ordering Information - https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ne5534.pdf
No SLOS070E found as of Sep 2026 - https://www.mouser.com/catalog/specsheets/texas%20instruments_ne5534.pdf (titled '(Rev. D)')
SLOS070C (revised Sep 2004) exists, frozen copy titled '(Rev. C)' - https://www.sigmaelectronica.net/manuals/NE5534.pdf
1990-era TI edition titled 'NE5534, NE5534A, SE5534, SE5534A LOW-NOISE OPERATIONAL AMPLIFIERS', SE −55 to 125 °C - http://www.ben.cz/_d/datasheet/ne5534.pdf

2004-era typo'd title 'SA5534. SA5534A' copies exist - https://www.mouser.com/catalog/specsheets/texas%20instruments_sa5534.pdf and https://www.capi-gear.com/catalog/images/gallery/opamps/IC/NE5534-datasheet.pdf
TI NE5534 datasheet gives 13 V/µs slew and 10 MHz UGBW - https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ne5534.pdf
PCN20231114002.1 (15 Nov 2023) cut NE5532 abs max ±22 V→±18 V and ESD 2 kV→1 kV - https://hackaday.com/2026/06/03/texas-instruments-changes-the-ne5532-and-others-into-incompatible-versions/
PCN20260429001.1 (30 Apr 2026) covers NE5532x/SA5532x datasheet changes - https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/8949/PCN20260429001.1.pdf
NE5534ADRG4 replaces NE5534AD (RoHS/REACH) and is not NRND or last-buy - https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/ne5534a-end-of-life-announced.405443/page-2
TI NE5534, NE5534A and NE5534P part-details pages are live - https://www.ti.com/product/NE5534A
onsemi NE5534/D is live with a ©2012 header, listing NE5534DR2G and NE5534AN - https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/ne5534-d.pdf
NJM5534D and NJM5534M are obsolete; NJM5534DD is available - https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM5534D/805754
Signetics operated Albuquerque fabs FAB22 and FAB23 (no link to an NE5534 redesign) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signetics
refuted_claims: TI's NE5532 redesign records no NE5534 change: SLOS070D (Nov 2014, ±22 V) is current; the only 2026 RFAB PCN found (20251017000.1A) covers SN74LVC logic.
PCN 20231114002 does not declare the NE5534 EOL: its device list (NE5532DR, SA5532ADR, LM833DR, MC33078DR, TL5580AIDR, RC4580IDR) omits it.
corrections: NJM5534D/M set to obsolete (DigiKey); NJM5534DD added as the current JRC/Nisshinbo orderable.
Added onsemi NE5534DR2G, the ©2012 NE5534/D file, product page and revision history.
SLOS070D: added the 'Changes from Revision C' list (template sections, Ordering Information deleted, no electrical changes).
Mouser texas instruments_sa5534.pdf attributed to SLOS070C (Sep 2004).
TI NE5532 PCN20231114002.1 and PCN20260429001.1 do not cover the NE5534; its abs max stays ±22 V.
NE5534AD EOL: NE5534ADRG4 replaces it (RoHS/REACH) and is not NRND; distributors have shown variants obsolete.
Albuquerque-fire folklore kept at low confidence; Signetics fabs FAB22/FAB23 documented; rival Caen fab-fire claim noted.
Raised confidence for datasheet URLs seen in results (TI, Mouser, sigmaelectronica, capi-gear, studylib, alldatasheet, ben.cz, onsemi).
Added mirrors: Mouser, DigiKey HTML, radiolocman, tomek.cedro.info, alldatasheet 27248 and 867190, RS Online onsemi copy.
13 V/µs slew and 10 MHz UGBW confirmed; SE −55 to 125 °C confirmed for the 1990-era edition.
